description: Get the full daily historical COVID-19 time series for one location, optionally windowed by start_date/end_date. Returns a curated subset of core fields per day: cases, deaths, hospitalizations, and vaccination totals (both new and cumulative), plus population. Does NOT return the raw upstream dataset which includes 700+ demographic/policy/search-trend columns. Use global-health-covid.location_search first to find a valid location_key. Data: Google "COVID-19 Open Data" (storage.googleapis.com/covid19-open-data), no auth required. HISTORICAL DATA ONLY — coverage ends ~2022-09, frozen dataset.

end_date.description: Filter history to dates on/before this ISO date, format "YYYY-MM-DD". Omit for full history.

location_key.description: Location key from the dataset, e.g. "US" (country), "US_CA" (state), or a deeper key discovered via global-health-covid.location_search.

start_date.description: Filter history to dates on/after this ISO date, format "YYYY-MM-DD". Omit for full history.

name: global-health-covid.epidemiology.location_history

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: COVID-19 Location History
